sos.title: Heat illness emergency help
sos.subtitle: Recognize the warning signs and act quickly.
sos.signs: Confusion, collapse, seizures, fainting, or very hot skin
sos.coolText: Move the person to a cooler shaded place. Loosen extra clothing and cool the skin with water and airflow.
sos.fluids: Do not give fluids to someone who is confused, unconscious, or unable to swallow safely.
sos.notice: This is emergency guidance, not a diagnosis. Do not delay emergency care.
recommendation.STOP_UNSAFE_ACTIVITY: Stop unsafe work and move away from the exposure.
recommendation.MAINTAIN_HYDRATION: Maintain hydration only when conscious and able to swallow safely.
recommendation.ESCALATE_TO_SUPERVISOR: Coordinate protective action with your supervisor.
recommendation.FIND_COOLING_RESOURCE: Find a nearby cooling, water or shade resource.
recommendation.MONITOR_SYMPTOMS: Watch for heat illness symptoms and use emergency guidance when needed.
